=== STEP 0 create_group
=== POST /api/2.0/preview/scim/v2/Groups
> {
  "displayName": "Initial Group",
  "entitlements": [
    {}
  ],
  "schemas": [
    "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:Group"
  ]
}
< 200
{
  "id": "group-id"
}

=== GET /api/2.0/preview/scim/v2/Groups/group-id?attributes=displayName,externalId,entitlements

  "displayName": "Initial Group",
  "id": "group-id"
}

=== GET /api/2.0/preview/scim/v2/Groups/group-id?attributes=displayName,externalId,entitlements
